title: Community Engagement Officer - Part-time
description:
Community Engagement Officer

Oxted, Surrey 29,000 FTE (pro rata) 16 hours per week 12-month fixed-term contract

Are you an organised, personable and community-minded individual who enjoys bringing people together, building relationships and making a positive difference?

We are working with a well-established local charity to recruit a Community Engagement Officer to support an exciting community partnership initiative across East Surrey.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with experience in administration, event coordination and communications who would enjoy a varied role working with local charities, community groups and voluntary organisations.

The Opportunity

Working as part of a small, supportive team, you will help connect local communities, organisations and services, ensuring that people's voices, experiences and priorities are heard.

This is a varied, hands-on position combining community engagement, administration, event organisation and communications. You will attend local meetings and forums, develop relationships with community organisations, help coordinate events and workshops, and support the delivery of newsletters, website updates and social media content.

The role is office-based in Oxted when not attending meetings or events, with regular travel throughout East Surrey.

Key Responsibilities

Community Engagement & Relationship Building
- Attend community meetings, local forums and neighbourhood partnership events across East Surrey.
- Build and maintain positive relationships with voluntary organisations, community groups and local partners.
- Listen to local concerns, experiences and priorities, capturing key information and sharing insights with the wider partnership team.
- Maintain accurate records of meetings attended, contacts made and issues raised.

Administration & Coordination
- Organise meetings, manage invitations, coordinate attendance and maintain diaries and schedules.
- Keep contact databases, meeting notes, records and action logs up to date.
- Respond to routine enquiries and provide general administrative and coordination support.
- Liaise with partner organisations to support effective communication and day-to-day activities.

Events & Activities
- Assist with organising community events, workshops and partnership meetings.
- Coordinate venues, bookings, invitations, refreshments and event materials.
- Support event registration, on-the-day arrangements and post-event follow-up.

Communications & Social Media
- Help prepare and distribute newsletters and updates to community partners.
- Draft short website articles, news items, event notices and community updates.
- Create and schedule social media posts promoting activities, events and opportunities.
- Gather stories, photographs and information from meetings and events to support engaging communications.

About You

We are looking for someone who is approachable, proactive and highly organised, with the confidence to communicate with a wide range of people and manage a varied workload.

You will ideally have:
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a friendly and approachable manner.
- Previous experience in administration, meeting organisation or activity coordination.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities independently.
- The ability to take accurate meeting notes and produce clear, concise written summaries.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Outlook and Word.
- Confidence using newsletters, websites and social media to share information.
- A flexible and positive approach, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- A full driving licence and the ability to travel regularly throughout East Surrey.
- The ability to work from the Oxted office when not attending external meetings or events.

description:
This is a hands-on Digital Marketing Executive role supporting the delivery and optimisation of performance marketing campaigns across channels including Paid Search, Paid Social, Display, YouTube and Demand Generation. - Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with agencies and stakeholders.

- Experience with platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager or GA4.

title: Franchise Marketing Manager
description:
Overview

As we continue to build a team that drives us forward, the Marketing team is excited to announce the opening for a Franchise Marketing Manager, EMEA, based at our European Headquarters in Egham, Surrey.

The Franchise Marketing Manager, EMEA, plays a critical role in driving brand growth and commercial performance across franchise markets throughout the EMEA region. Working closely with franchise partners, this role leverages business insights to identify opportunities, deliver strategic marketing value, and accelerate growth for the Enterprise, National, and Alamo brands.

Serving as a trusted advisor to EMEA franchise partners, this position provides marketing consultation and guidance across full-funnel marketing initiatives to achieve business objectives while also leading cross-market initiatives that build consideration and demand to drive reservations.

To succeed in this role you will bring previous end to end marketing experience, great communication skills with the ability to build relationships, and experiencewithin the digital marketing environment. You will be equally comfortable developing strategy, influencing partners, and translating insights into actionable plans that deliver measurable business results.

As part of the Franchise EMEA Marketing team, this role collaborates closely with internal Marketing, Revenue Management, and Operations teams, as well as external agency partners.

Organisation Overview:

We're Enterprise Mobility. A family-owned, global mobility leader with a $39 billion turnover, nearly 90,000 team members, and operations in 95 countries. Led by CEO Chrissy Taylor, the third generation of the Taylor family, we're built on a legacy that gives us the stability to focus on the long-term success of our people, our customers and our business.

From a fleet of seven cars, more than six decades ago, to a global network serving consumers, businesses and governments, Enterprise Mobility is a leading provider of mobility solutions including car rental, fleet management, flexible vehicle-hire, carsharing, vanpooling, car sales, truck rental, vehicle subscription, luxury rental, technology solutions and more, to help make travel easier and more convenient.

Additional Information:

Location: Egham, Surrey, TW20 9 FB (Plenty of free on site parking and approx. 15 minutes walk from Egham station)

Salary: Competitive salary and benefits package

Hours: 45 per week, Hybrid, 3 days in the office, 2 days working from home.

Please let us know about any accommodations you may need to participate in the recruitment process.

Please note that all applicants must have the ability to pass a security check involving financial probity and basic criminality.

Responsibilities
- Work with partners to help them develop tailored marketing plans, which outline specific strategies and tactics designed to capitalize on the opportunities identified and agreed upon for their individual markets
- Consult with internal and external partners, industry resources and data to develop insights to share with franchise partners that shape marketing programs and campaigns
- Apply disciplined/ROI approach to measurement in partnership w/ marketing peers and available tools (i.e. Adobe Analytics, Data Studio).
- Demonstrate strong analytical skills to identify data-driven tactics and solutions
- Demonstrate the ability to think critically and implement a broad range of marketing and full-funnel solutions.
- Share best practices based across the franchise network
- Serve as the support resource for revenue-driving campaign strategies throughout the region, including but not limited to Organic Search, Paid Search, Affiliate, Web Development, Offers, and Digital Teams
- Keep apprised of all relevant partner, industry and market developments
- Coordinate project timing and budgets
- Seek out new opportunities and play a supportive role in their development
- Continuously work to upgrade knowledge and skills through available reading, courses and seminars
- Provide monthly status on key initiatives; measures and reports progress
- Seek to improve job performance through self-assessment, skill development, training and goal setting
- Maintain a regular and reliable level of attendance and punctuality
- Perform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned

Qualifications

Essential Requirements:
- Proven experience in full-funnel marketing planning and campaign management.
- Significant experience in comprehensive end-to-end marketing.
- The ability to influence stakeholders and work effectively across multiple markets and cultures.
- Outstanding communication and relationship-building abilities.
- Ability to juggle multiple responsibilities, meet deadlines and prioritise to complete work on a timely basis
- Excellent organisation and time-management skills
- Ability to travel 2-3 times per quarter.
- Demonstrated experience in the digital marketing spectrum from web development to digital acquisition channels (SEO, PPC, Affiliate, etc)

Preferred Experience:
- Franchise marketing or client-facing experience, with hotel, airline, or other travel industry experience preferred but not required

title: Head of External Affairs
company: Murray McIntosh Associates Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Murray McIntosh is proud to partner with Future Biogas, one of the UK's leading developers, owners and operators of anaerobic digestion and biomethane infrastructure. Operating 11 sites nationwide and backed by major infrastructure investors, the business is helping corporates decarbonise through renewable gas today while developing the next generation of carbon-negative energy projects.

As the business enters an exciting new phase of growth, Future Biogas is creating a Head of External Affairs role to strengthen its influence across government, regulators, industry and the wider stakeholder landscape.

This is a unique opportunity to establish and lead a new function at the centre of one of the UK's most innovative clean energy businesses.

The Opportunity

Working closely with the CEO and wider senior leadership, you will ensure Future Biogas is represented in the right conversations, building relationships that support both the business and the wider energy transition.

You'll sit at the intersection of policy, communications, business development and commercial strategy, helping to shape how Future Biogas engages with Government ministers and officials, regulators and policymakers, industry associations, corporate stakeholders and key partners across energy, agriculture and sustainability.

The role will operate with a high degree of autonomy, responsible for managing the external affairs function and associated budget.
- Lead the external affairs, development of FB's parliamentary profile and government stakeholder engagement activities.
- Create the relationships needed to help identify and influence policy developments across government, quasi-governmental organisations and NGO's that impact the business.
- Provide strategic advice on political and external affairs and reputational issues in conjunction with Policy, Comms and other FB teams as relevant.
- Support business development, planning and growth opportunities through effective stakeholder engagement.

We're interested in speaking with individuals who can demonstrate:
- Degree or equivalent experience in Public Affairs, Politics, Communications, Business or a related discipline
- Proven experience in public affairs, government relations or policy development within a related industry
- Excellent influencing, communication and stakeholder management skills
- Strong commercial awareness and strategic thinking
- Experience of leading and developing small, high-performing teams

Most importantly, you'll be a natural relationship-builder who enjoys opening doors, creating opportunities and bringing the right people together.

You'll combine strategic thinking with strong political awareness and have the credibility to engage confidently with senior stakeholders both internally and externally.

What's on Offer?
- A newly created leadership role with significant exposure to CEO and executive team and the opportunity to build and shape a function
- Competitive salary with performance-related bonus and excellent benefits package

Location: Future Biogas' headquarters are based in Guildford, with a new office opening within the Surrey Research Park. With a hybrid working model, the business already attracts talent from London and the South East, supported by strong rail links and shuttle transport.

If you're excited by the prospect of helping shape the future of renewable energy, carbon removals and UK sustainability policy, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager

37 hours per week (Significant part time of four days per week considered)

Term time plus one week

The Role

The role of Marketing Manager is central to promoting the College, enhancing its reputation and ensuring that its marketing activities effectively support student recruitment and engagement. We are looking for a creative, organised and proactive individual who can lead the College's marketing function, manage a varied programme of events and campaigns, and maintain strong relationships with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.

The successful candidate will be an excellent communicator with strong organisational skills and the ability to balance strategic planning with day-to-day operational delivery. You will be confident managing multiple projects, analysing the effectiveness of marketing activities, and working collaboratively with colleagues across the College to ensure a consistent and impactful approach to marketing and communications.

This is a highly visible role involving regular interaction with students, parents, local schools, alumni, media organisations, external suppliers and College staff. You will therefore need to be approachable, professional and adaptable, with the ability to build positive relationships and represent the College effectively at a variety of events and meetings.

We have high expectations of all our staff, and applicants should clearly demonstrate both their suitability for the role and their alignment with the College's values. We strongly encourage candidates to review the job description carefully and explore our website to gain a deeper understanding of our ethos, ambitions and community.

The Marketing Manager will work closely with the Senior Leadership Team, Heads of Department, Director of Enhancement and Cultural Capital, amongst others. The role also involves working with local schools, media organisations, alumni, external suppliers and community partners. It is a varied and engaging position, with responsibility for coordinating major College events, managing marketing projects and contributing to the College's wider strategic objectives.

Hours: 37 hours per week, term-time only plus one additional week (40 weeks total). The additional week can be discussed further at interview, however, two of these days must be worked in August around the A Level and GCSE summer exam results. The Marketing Manager role will be based on-site, and the College's core day is 8.30am to 4pm

Salary: Actual pro rata salary: £38,860 to £40,805 pa (37 hours per week, term time plus one week), FTE £43,930 to £46,128 per annum

All figures are inclusive of fringe allowance and depend on experience.

Why work with us?

Woking College has a strong sense of community in which everyone is valued; we look forward to welcoming new members of staff to join our team.

We have an inclusive ethos and are proud of our diverse students and staff community. The College is committed to safeguarding, alongside our core values of inclusiveness, adhering to the highest personal, professional and academic standards, supporting individual wellbeing through an encouraging management team, positive relationships and a sustainable future for all. We expect all staff, volunteers and others involved in the College community to share this commitment.

Application and selection

Application forms are available to download from our website.

We would like to see your passion for the role in your supporting statement, please use this opportunity to include:
- personal skills and previous marketing and brand experience that are relevant to this role;
- what you will bring to the College community and why you feel you would be successful in this post;
- training you have undertaken to enable you to be successful in your role;
- Please ensure education and employment history are completed fully, gaps in employment must be accounted for under the section entitled "Periods when not working".

Closing date: 9am, Monday 7 December 2026

Interviews to be held: Monday 14 December 2026

Please note that CVs will not be accepted on their own, and all applicants must be able to evidence their Right to Work in the UK - the College is unable to sponsor work visas.

All candidates will receive an application acknowledgement. Please note that, due to time constraints, it is not possible to inform candidates who have been unsuccessful at short-listing.

Full details of the interview day will be provided to shortlisted candidates. In line with safer recruitment practices, references will be requested prior to interview wherever possible.

Safeguarding

Woking College is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. This post is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 and successful applicants will be subject to Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) checks. The College is committed to equal opportunities.

The College encourages all candidates to be familiar with the following documents, which are available to view on the College's Staff Vacancies page:
- Section 1 of the DfE paper on "Keeping Children Safe in Education" September 2026;
- Woking College's Safeguarding and Child Protection Policy;
- In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the College asks candidates to consider the Privacy Notice for Job Applicants.

As part of the College's commitment to Keeping Children Safe in Education, statutory checks will be carried out as part of the recruitment process, which will include:
- Ensuring gaps in employment history are explained;
- Checking ID and relevant qualifications;
- Following up on references for shortlisted candidates;
- Ensuring the successful candidate(s) has an up-to-date Enhanced DBS, Prohibition check (teaching staff) and Section 128 (where appropriate).
- Carrying out an online search in advance of the successful candidate being offered a role.
